name: home-hero
prompt: Photoreal cinematic luxury editorial, single hero still. A hand-bound brand book in soft pearl (#F2F1ED) linen rests off-centre on a slab of honed travertine, its spine embossed with an antique-gold hairline and a small 'ds' monogram. From its cover a single ribbon of deep crimson-depth (#710014) silk unfurls upward and catches one warm, low-angle key light raking from the left, the only saturated colour in an otherwise obsidian-black (#161618) and warm-sand (#B38F6F) tonal world. Behind, a blurred mashrabiya screen throws soft geometric shadow; the right two-thirds of the frame is deliberate negative space in graded espresso darkness for a headline overlay. Shallow depth of field, 100mm compression, fine film grain, deep controlled shadow, one specular glint on the gold. Nothing floats, everything grounded and tactile. Museum-quiet, market-leader confidence. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: home-approach

name: about-founder
prompt: Photoreal editorial portrait, magazine-cover calibre. A composed founder photographed three-quarter, seated on a low leather chair against a tadelakt plaster wall the colour of warm sand (#B38F6F), quiet confidence rather than a grin, gaze slightly off-lens. A single soft key light from a tall window rakes one side of the face; the rest falls into rich obsidian (#161618) chiaroscuro shadow. Wardrobe is understated pearl (#F2F1ED) and espresso tailoring. The one bold accent: a folded crimson-depth (#710014) pocket square, deliberate and small, catching the light. A slim antique-gold ring hairline and a discreet 'ds' lapel pin. 135mm long lens for flattering compression, creamy separation, shallow depth of field, fine medium-format grain, restrained warm grade. Negative space above the shoulder. Timeless, unhurried, expensive. Aspect ratio 4:5.
